name: Equinix Bloom Energy fuel-cell programme
location: About 19 Equinix data centres, primarily the United States (IBX sites)
description: Equinix's decade-long partnership with Bloom Energy, expanded in 2025, deploying more than 100 MW of natural-gas solid-oxide fuel cells at about 19 data centres as on-site generation that bypasses grid interconnection queues and improves power reliability for colocation customers.

capacities.basis: more than 100 MW across about 19 data centres (about 37 MW across 12 sites as of 2017)
